item.title: US-led Gaza peace board warns Hamas over kites after Israeli threat
item.description: The US-led board overseeing the Gaza peace plan warned Hamas on Tuesday to halt militant activity, including flying kites, after Israel threatened retaliatory strikes. A Board of Peace official said Israel must also respect the ceasefire, limiting military action to responses to “genuine and imminent threats.”

item.title: Middle East live: Iran says Hormuz strait still closed despite transit corridor talks with Oman
item.description: President Donald Trump on Wednesday said he believes Iran’s Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei is “very seriously wounded”, but not dead. Khamenei has not been seen in public since the US and Israel launched the Iran war in February, prompting months of speculation over the new Iranian leader’s health. Follow our liveblog to see how the day's events unfolded.

item.title: Israel's Netanyahu says Iran tried to assassinate one of his sons
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said on Monday that Iran had attempted to assassinate one of his two sons, without providing evidence or further details. “Iran tried to kill one of my sons,” Netanyahu told Israel’s Channel 14, as he discussed security arrangements ahead of the October 27 election.

item.title: Israel army carries out rare West Bank air strike, killing 'three terrorists'
item.description: Israel's military said it carried out an air strike in the Jenin area in the West Bank on Friday that killed a ​Palestinian it described as a Hamas militant operative as well as two of his accomplices, in a rare use of deadly Israeli air power in the occupied territory.

item.title: Iran weighs harsh penalties for contact with outside media in ‘foreign influence’ bill
item.description: The push comes nearly six months after the U.S. and Israel launched the war, with no immediate diplomatic breakthrough in sight.

item.title: Iran tried to assassinate one of Netanyahu's sons, prime minister says
item.description: Benjamin Netanyahu claims Iran tried to murder one of his sons, urging enhanced protection for prime ministerial candidates during the election campaign.

item.title: US plans to cut off military aid to key Middle East ally, BBC told
item.description: Iraqi Kurdistan fears the Trump administration's plan will make the region more vulnerable to further attacks from Iran.

item.title: Why Many Iranians Are Losing Hope After Six Months of War
item.description: Iranians have become increasingly desperate, as they grapple with an economic crisis made worse by the conflict and grow increasingly skeptical about President Trump’s motives.

item.title: UN agency warns of 17,000 children in urgent need of assistance as aid reaches some Nepal survivors
item.description: Aid has begun to reach survivors of the catastrophic flash floods that swept through the mountainous border region between Nepal and China

item.title: Somali piracy surges as the impact of the US-Iran war ripples outwards
item.description: Two ships were seized within four days last week raising to at least 13 the number attacked since January.
